title: Rightward search for a tape boundary
statement: For an alphabet of symbols, a number $k$ of work tapes, and a selected tape $i$ among them, define a machine with four phases: run, gap, back, and done. It starts in run; while scanning tape $i$, it moves right and remains in run on a nonblank symbol, and moves right into gap on a blank. In gap it moves right and returns to run on a nonblank symbol; on a blank it enters done without moving the input head. In back it stays in place on tape $i$ and enters done, while in done it stays in place; these transitions make no writes or outputs.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A selected tape $i$ among the $k$ work tapes
